 The staggering net worth of China's richest woman revealed
 Maroosha Muzaffar Friday 30 October 2026 13:18 GMT 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover Related: This is the net worth you need to be considered rich in America Zhou Qunfei, founder of glass manufacturing giant Lens Technology, has reclaimed her spot as China 's richest woman on the Hurun Richest Women in China 2026 list.
 The 56-year-old former factory worker's fortune increased by 15 per cent over the past year to an estimated 127bn yuan (approximately £14.20bn).
 Ms Zhou started her career earning $1.20 a day in a watch-glass factory before establishing her own business, which grew rapidly after becoming a key supplier for Apple 's iPhones in 2007.
 Lens Technology has since diversified its operations into electric vehicles, artificial intelligence-related hardware, and robotics to mitigate market risks.
 According to the report, 65 per cent of the 50 richest women in China are self-made, while ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming topped the overall national rich list.
